page_title: How to Build a Chat Application using React, Redux, Redux-Saga, and Web Sockets

summary.title: How to Build a Chat Application using React, Redux, Redux-Saga, and Web Sockets
summary.one_liner: You learn to build a basic broadcast chat room with a React and Redux front end, Redux-Saga side effects, and a Node.js WebSocket server.
keywords: jest tests for redux actions and reducers
how to handle side effects in redux
build a chat room from scratch
takeaways: Set up a create-react-app project and build a static chat layout with CSS Grid
Manage chat state with Redux actions and reducers, using container and presentational components connected via react-redux
Run a Node.js WebSocket server with the ws library that registers users and broadcasts messages and user lists
Use redux-saga middleware to send ADD_MESSAGE actions over the browser's native WebSocket
Write Jest tests for actions, reducers and presentational components
summary.summary: The tutorial walks through building a basic chat room where each connecting user gets a generated username and can broadcast messages to all connected clients. It starts with a create-react-app project and a static CSS Grid layout, then adds Redux state management with container and presentational components. The server side uses Node.js and the ws library, and the client uses the native browser WebSocket. Redux-Saga handles the side effect of sending messages over the socket, and Jest tests cover actions, reducers and components.
